facts.business: Paul Merchants Limited is an Authorized Dealer Category II licensed by RBI, primarily engaged in the sale and purchase of foreign exchange and related travel/forex products through its branch network across India.
key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to complexity and large volume of foreign exchange transactions
Regulatory risk from FEMA adjudication orders and penalties (Rs. 396 lakhs and Rs. 1.2 lakhs demands pending appeal)
Tax litigation risk from Income Tax demand of Rs. 97.50 lakhs for FY 2014-15 pending appeal
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with Directors: Mr. Rajneesh Bansal (MD) - Travel/Forex products worth Rs. 30,14,615; Mr. Ritesh Vaid (WTD) - Travel products worth Rs. 12,500. Loans to wholly owned subsidiaries outstanding Rs. 6,041.08 Lakhs as on 31.03.2025, pledged for credit facilities.
